about: The releases of Orkcraft, newest first: what an installed copy reads to update itself (docs/updates.md). A release marked critical installs by itself when the town opens.

releases.notes: Each AI tool now runs on the newest model of its tier's family: agy and Codex are asked once a day which models they have (agy models, codex debug models), so a new Gemini or GPT model is used without an Orkcraft update. When a tool cannot say, Orkcraft names no model and the tool uses its own default. A model you chose by its version in the settings, a building or a task still runs as you wrote it. The tier picker shows the version in use, e.g. Gemini Flash High (3.8). Costs of a model missing from the price table use the nearest version of its family.

When an AI tool fails (not installed, not signed in, a usage limit or overload, no network), the window says which tool and what happened, with Switch to another installed tool (it becomes the main tool and the failed step runs again), Retry, and Details with the tool's own error to copy.

orkcraft started outside a project (for example in your home folder right after installing) no longer stops with "project root not found": the town opens in ~/Orkcraft and says how to open a project's town. orkcraft hooks and feedback outside a project now say what to do.

Your mascot is drawn for your role: eleven heads, each growing its own headgear stage by stage (a keyword tag and rating stars for the ASO gnome, a megaphone and a growth arrow for the marketing one).
Orkcraft updates itself: critical fixes install by themselves when the town opens, other updates are offered.
